prompt: I want to build something in the mental health space for college students but I only have a vague sense of the problem. Can you help me shape this into something concrete?

assertions.text: Handles the vague starting point without making premature assumptions
Asks probing questions to narrow the focus within mental health
Helps arrive at a concrete product concept from the vague idea
Evaluates viability of the refined concept
Identifies risks specific to the mental health space (regulation, sensitivity, clinical vs wellness)
Produces a structured Big Idea deliverable file
Updates or references the dependency tracking system
